# monitorable_alert_templates (Data Source)

Lists the organization's alert templates. Templates are managed in the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monitorable_alert_templates" "all" {}

output "default_template_id" {
  value = one([for t in data.monitorable_alert_templates.all.templates : t.id if t.is_default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) The alert templates, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The template id, a decimal integer.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default template, the one servers follow when none is assigned.
- `name` (String) The template's name.
